use onc_rpc_xdr::{XdrDecode, XdrEncode};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct copy_request_t {
    pub job_id: crate::common_types::job_id_t,
    pub job_update: crate::transfer_types::job_update_t,
    pub source_instance: crate::transfer_types::instance_info_t,
}

impl XdrEncode for copy_request_t {
    fn encode_xdr(&self, output: &mut bytes::BytesMut) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        self.job_id.encode_xdr(output)?;
        self.job_update.encode_xdr(output)?;
        self.source_instance.encode_xdr(output)?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

impl XdrDecode for copy_request_t {
    fn decode_xdr(input: &mut &[u8]) -> Result<Self, onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        Ok(Self {
            job_id: <crate::common_types::job_id_t as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
            job_update: <crate::transfer_types::job_update_t as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
            source_instance: <crate::transfer_types::instance_info_t as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
        })
    }
}

impl onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments for copy_request_t {
    fn encode_xdr_segments(&self, output: &mut onc_rpc_xdr::SegmentEncoder) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&self.job_id, output)?;
        onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&self.job_update, output)?;
        onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&self.source_instance, output)?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

pub mod blob_service {
    pub const PROGRAM: u32 = 200001;

    pub mod blob_service_v1 {
        pub const VERSION: u32 = 1;
        pub const BLOB_NULL: u32 = 0;
        pub const BLOB_COPY: u32 = 1;
    }

}

/// Metadata-only projection; the terminal opaque body remains in caller storage.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct copy_request_tMetadata {
    pub job_id: crate::common_types::job_id_t,
    pub job_update: crate::transfer_types::job_update_t,
    pub source_instance: crate::transfer_types::instance_info_tMetadata,
}

impl XdrDecode for copy_request_tMetadata {
    fn decode_xdr(input: &mut &[u8]) -> Result<Self, onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        Ok(Self {
            job_id: <crate::common_types::job_id_t as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
            job_update: <crate::transfer_types::job_update_t as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
            source_instance: <crate::transfer_types::instance_info_tMetadata as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
        })
    }
}

impl onc_rpc_xdr::XdrReplyMetadata for copy_request_tMetadata {
    const MAX_PREFIX_BYTES: usize = 16;
    fn opaque_len(&self) -> Option<usize> { onc_rpc_xdr::XdrReplyMetadata::opaque_len(&self.source_instance) }
}

/// Alternate argument representation retaining multiple owners for one terminal opaque body.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct copy_request_tSegments {
    pub job_id: crate::common_types::job_id_t,
    pub job_update: crate::transfer_types::job_update_t,
    pub source_instance: crate::transfer_types::instance_info_tSegments,
}

impl XdrEncode for copy_request_tSegments {
    fn encode_xdr(&self, output: &mut bytes::BytesMut) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        self.job_id.encode_xdr(output)?;
        self.job_update.encode_xdr(output)?;
        self.source_instance.encode_xdr(output)?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

impl XdrDecode for copy_request_tSegments {
    fn decode_xdr(input: &mut &[u8]) -> Result<Self, onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        Ok(Self {
            job_id: <crate::common_types::job_id_t as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
            job_update: <crate::transfer_types::job_update_t as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
            source_instance: <crate::transfer_types::instance_info_tSegments as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
        })
    }
}

impl onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments for copy_request_tSegments {
    fn encode_xdr_segments(&self, output: &mut onc_rpc_xdr::SegmentEncoder) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&self.job_id, output)?;
        onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&self.job_update, output)?;
        onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&self.source_instance, output)?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

impl From<copy_request_t> for copy_request_tSegments {
    fn from(value: copy_request_t) -> Self { Self {
        job_id: value.job_id,
        job_update: value.job_update,
        source_instance: value.source_instance.into(),
    } }
}
